newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Multipolar to pay 673 bln for Matahari.
newsitem.headline: Multipolar to pay 673 bln for Matahari.

text.p: Indonesian retail and information technology company PT Multipolar Corporation will pay 673 billion rupiah in cash and notes for a 45 percent stake in retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima, Matahari said on Monday.

Multipolar, a member of the diversified Lippo Group, will pay for the investment through a proposed rights issue in May or June next year, Matahari and Lippo said in a joint statement issued at an analysts' meeting.
The statement said Multipolar will pay 61.88 billion rupiah in cash, 300 billion rupiah in 12 months non-interest bearing notes and 311 billion rupiah in 24 months non-interest bearing notes.

Multipolar will finance the investment through a proposed rights issue either in May or June next year, and under the deal the notes issued are payable from the proceeds of the rights issue, the statement said.

Multipolar has been granted an unconditional and irrevocable option from Mataharijaya Putraperkasa, Matahari's holding company headed by founder Hari Darmawan, to purchase 45 percent of existing shares of Matahari, the statement said.
The statement said Multipolar on Monday initiated a tender offer to buy a further 5.1 percent stake in Matahari.
Multipolar and Matahari will work together to expand and further dominate the retail market and their combined 1996 revenue is expected at almost two trillion rupiah.
The statement said their combined revenue was forecast to rise to 15 trillion rupiah in eight years.
